The subject's hair and body seamlessly transform into a breathtaking autumn landscape. A magnificent golden-orange tree grows from their head, with dense fiery red, amber, copper, and burnt-orange foliage. Inside their head, blend a glowing sunset city skyline with modern skyscrapers, warm sunlight, and atmospheric depth. Use a [COLOR_PALETTE: amber and orange] color palette, vertical 4:5 composition, ultra-detailed, high resolution.
